container_details.notes: Polymaker brand-wide announcement (Aug 2021) covering all Polymaker filaments; PolyMide is a Polymaker line. The CoPA product page confirms a 0.75kg cardboard spool but does not restate the recycled share.
container_details.source_quote: Moving forward, Polymaker will produce all filaments on a 100% recycled cardboard spools.
